notes.title: 📖 Final Quest Almost Ready – Update + Personal Note 📖
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/a66d264acb5bc9a931e7d2b4e6fcea967f902733.jpg"]

Good news first:
All videos for the 4th and final quest of the upcoming free content update are now complete!
All that’s left is rendering a few still frames and coding the last quest.

As usual, I’ve included sneak peeks from new scenes 👀


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/7f0320defbabe7baf0fa746e22774eb4fbbde4db.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/280e7d9ea72e4c27f880dba43f8844aa9c1ac05c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/81293d760528bd98e7c4470172b4c5d65b89a244.jpg"][/carousel]


📝 A Quick Personal Note:

The update took longer than I expected. I want to apologize for the delay.

Part of the reason was… me. I realized I’ve been procrastinating more than usual lately.
Maybe it’s fear—after seeing some recent censorship incidents, I started to worry my game might get taken down too.
Maybe it’s because the game is already out, and somewhere deep in my mind I gave myself permission to slow down.
I’m not entirely sure.

Originally, I wanted to release a Next Fest demo for a new game this October, but I’ve postponed that plan to the winter nextfest instead.

That said, I wasn’t completely idle.

During this time, I’ve been planning out the story arcs, characters, and structure for Game 2 and Game 3 of the Lustborne Chronicle series.

You’ll definitely see characters from Memory of Lust again—and their stories will continue.
The narrative continuity between the games will be tight and satisfying. 💫

I’m also in the early planning phase of a completely separate project set in the modern day... more on that later.
[hr][/hr]
So, long story short:
Thank you for your patience. I’m sorry for the delay. The free content update is coming very soon!

❤️

notes.title: 🌹 Update Preview – "Gold, Gus and Roses" Quest Incoming! 🌹
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/069390c39d18b7b2e10274d66f63fc2c1d37deee.jpg"]As part of the free content update, the third new quest is currently in development!

Titled "Gold, Guns and Roses," this story unfolds in the bustling market area, where a mysterious prophecy promises fortune… if you're bold (and reckless) enough to chase it.
Expect themes of desire, ambition, and temptation—all wrapped.

The quest isn’t finished yet, but here are some sneak peeks from scenes:

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/510cb074ff5d27ea9581c9cef563de9f36ce1062.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/6195f1f429f6838ff3ec906c9314ce456f953232.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/2658876b6fe22effb1abfd335a4058d35f5d8f94.jpg"][/carousel]


🛠️ Steam Policy Note:

Due to recent changes, one bath scene from the prologue has been removed.
That said, none of the remaining content includes incest or non-consensual elements, so we don’t expect further issues—but Steam is Steam, and things can always change.

Thank you for your continued support! 💛

As always, feel free to suggest scenes you'd like to see next!

notes.title: 🔧 Update Incoming – Thanks to the Community!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/1e27c4cb56ef8be9899013f071c3f94c52ab6f9e.jpg"]Hey everyone!  

A new update is here — and it wouldn’t have been possible without the help of one of our amazing community members, dsperado. Huge thanks to them for pointing out some really important issues!



🛠 What’s new in this update?

A tutorial has been added at the beginning of the game to help new players get started.

Some confusing sections have been adjusted to improve clarity and flow.

Several bugs and inconsistencies reported by dsperado have been fixed.

💬 If you come across any bugs, confusing moments, or issues, please don’t hesitate to message me. I’m committed to fixing problems as quickly as possible, and your feedback helps the game improve for everyone!

🆕 Also — a new demo update is coming very soon!
It will offer a more polished experience and reflect a limited portion of the game’s current state. If you haven’t tried the demo yet, or want to see how things have improved, keep an eye out!

Thanks for playing and supporting the game 💙

notes.title: 🔥 Release Date Announcement 🔥
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457711/309f690b61783b3316baf483010d6296402179fc.png

Welcome to the world of Memory of Lust — a darkly sensual visual novel where the boundaries between memory, desire, and identity blur into one unforgettable journey.

🗓️ The game officially launches on June 16th, and it's packed with content:

✨ 8 fully-developed quest routes, each with unique characters, storylines, and emotionally charged moments.  
🎞️ Over 100 animated scenes — carefully crafted to bring the story and its sensual encounters to life.  
🖼️ More than **650 static CG scenes**, detailing the world, characters, and dramatic turning points in rich visual storytelling.

🧠 The core narrative is now complete, allowing you to uncover the truth behind your memory loss, rediscover who you really are, and unravel the secrets hidden within the mysterious town you've found yourself in.

But this is only the beginning.

🔜 In the upcoming months, we’ll be adding free updates that include:
- New side quests and optional scenes
- Additional story arcs
- Fresh character interactions and world-expanding content

All updates will be 100% free for all players — no paid DLCs, no cut content. Just more story, more passion, and more answers.

💖 Wishlist Memory of Lust now and get ready to begin your descent into mystery, memory, and desire on June 16th.
